description: This file defines API routes for session management in a web application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete sessions, utilizing a Supabase client for database interactions. The routes are prefixed with '/sessions' and include detailed descriptions and response models for documentation. It also manages environment variables for configuration.

classes.name: SessionsList
classes.description: A container for a list of session objects, used as a response model.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a session object with properties like id, title, user_id, created_at, etc.

classes.name: SessionCreate
classes.description: Model used for creating a new session, typically includes fields like title.

classes.name: SessionUpdate
classes.description: Model used for updating an existing session, such as changing the title.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for URL and keys.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific session by ID, ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the title of a session, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a session, ensuring ownership.
